## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 246 captures during November 2025. This activity provides the basis for the month’s image-quality review and subsequent grading outcomes. The capture volume should continue to be monitored through routine site reporting, with any operational matters noted as they arise.

## Image quality

A total of 2 captures were assessed as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 0.8 of all captures. The clinic should continue to check image quality at the point of capture and address any recurring camera issues promptly. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so they can be followed up through the usual support process.

## Grading

There were 71 referable results during November 2025. The median grading wait was 2 days. These results should be considered alongside the capture activity and image-quality findings when reviewing site performance for the month. Continued attention to camera operation, image quality, and timely submission will support consistent grading and help identify any issues requiring further action.
